name: @studio/audio-analysis
description: Measuring and re-encoding an audio FILE: decode it (the engine's `--decode` where there is one, WebAssembly otherwise, ffmpeg for a format WebAssembly cannot open), build the `{file}.cache` sidecar — peak/RMS/three-band envelope, onsets, tempo — read its true peak, and write it again as Opus/WebM, FLAC or WAV on a worker pool. The only producer of the sidecar. Node-only, unlike @studio/audio-probe, which only MEASURES already-decoded audio. Consumed as source.
